sources.quote: HD 45866, also designated HR 2363 and named Kamelos, is a solitary star located in the northern circumpolar constellation Camelopardalis.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 416 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,058 K, so 41.323 solar radii.
